'''Izushi Kokoro no Ōomi no Mikoto''' (出石心大臣命, 生没年不詳) was an ancient Japanese nobleman, regarded as an ancestor of the {{ill|Hozumi clan|ja|穂積氏|qid=Q11597079}} and {{ill|Mononobe clan|de|Mononobe (Klan)|es|Clan Mononobe|fa|خاندان مونونوبه|fr|Clan Mononobe|id|Klan Mononobe|it|Clan Mononobe|ja|物部氏|ko|모노노베씨|nl|Mononobe-clan|pt|Clã Mononobe|ru|Мононобэ (род)|sh|Mononobe|uk|Рід Мононобе|vi|Gia tộc Mononobe|zh|物部氏|zh_classical|物部氏|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe clan}}.

== Overview ==

According to the "Tennō Honki" chapter of the {{ill|Kujiki|ar|كجيكي|fa|کوجیکی (سندای کوجی هونگی)|fr|Kujiki|id|Kujiki|it|Kujiki|ja|先代旧事本紀|ko|선대구사본기|pt|Kujiki|ru|Кудзики|uk|Кудзікі|vi|Cựu sự kỷ|zh|先代舊事本紀|qid=Q2716751|lt=Sendai Kuji Hongi}}, Izushi Kokoro no Mikoto became an {{ill|Omi (title)|fa|او-اومی|ja|大臣 (古代日本)|ru|О-оми|uk|О-омі|qid=Q4328809|lt=Ōomi}} in the first year of Emperor Kōshō’s reign during autumn. The "Tenson Honki" chapter corroborates this and adds that he served as a priest for the {{ill|Ōkami|ja|大神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkami|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10937139}} at {{ill|Isonokami Jingū|de|Isonokami-jingū|eo|Sanktejo Isonokami|fr|Isonokami-jingū|ja|石上神宮|ko|이소노카미진구 신궁|la|Isonokami Templum|ru|Исоноками-дзингу|uk|Ісонокамі-дзінгу|zh|石上神宮|qid=Q708859|lt=Isonokami Shrine}}.

== Genealogy ==

The "Tenson Honki" identifies Izushi Kokoro no Ōomi no Mikoto as the great-grandson of {{ill|Nigihayahi|fr|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|simple|Nigihayahi|zh|饒速日命|qid=Q10949054|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}} and the sibling of {{ill|Izumo Shikō no Ōomi no Mikoto|ja|出雲醜大臣命}} and {{ill|Kami Ōne|ja|大禰命|lt=Ōne no Mikoto}}. His maternal lineage is traced to {{ill|Awami Kawakarehime|ja|淡海川枯姫}}, with no conflicting traditions recorded.
